# library-of-alexandria

Public archive of interactive lessons.

This repo is the **published** subset of [librarian-of-alexandria](https://github.com/epoplive/librarian-of-alexandria).
Lessons are authored there; this repo holds the player + lesson content that deploys to GitHub Pages.

**Do not edit files in this repo directly** — changes will be overwritten on the next publish.

Last published from librarian-of-alexandria @ `b7f5254`.

## Local preview
```
npm install
npm run dev
```
